featured_reviews.name: Anfal Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently visited the Aditya Birla Nirlon office in Mumbai to complete the closure of my loan, and it was by far the most frustrating and disappointing experience I've had with any financial institution.
First, I had to wait for over 60 minutes just to be attended to, despite having an appointment and arriving on time. There was no proper queue management or update system, which made the long wait even more irritating.
Once I finally got to the counter, the staff sitting there showed zero empathy or basic courtesy. They didn't even greet me or acknowledge the customer properly. Their attitude was completely indifferent, as if helping with loan closure was a burden rather than their job.
Worse still, the staff seemed to have no clear idea about the process or documentation required. They provided confusing and incomplete information, kept asking me to wait or come back with more papers without explaining why, and appeared clueless about what they were doing. Multiple follow-ups and repeated complaints from my side didn't help improve the situation at all.
This was hands down the worst customer service I've encountered. If you're planning to close a loan with Aditya Birla Finance, I strongly recommend trying online options (if available) or another branch, because this Nirlon office made what should be a straightforward process into a nightmare.
Avoid if possible — 1/5 stars.
